command: cd libs/<name> && zig build test --summary all
note: The root `zig build test` runs the same 29 binaries and reports the same total, because the root step compiles the `tests/` roots as well as the inline src/ tests. Re-derive with the command above; a test added without moving this file fails `zig build counts-check`. Recent movements: `merkle` 20 -> 26 for the Bitcoin vectors, `poly` 32 -> 34 for the Horner parity test, `field` 91 -> 89 when its own Merkle tree was deleted and its four tests moved onto `zig-merkle`, `algebra-traits` 8 -> 9, `hash` 22 -> 23 and `rng` 27 -> 28 for three `pub` bodies that nothing called.
